title: Enterprise Connectivity: source billed subtotal
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this source billed subtotal rule to assisted correction posting.

## Basis: source
For assisted correction posting, read the posted net service subtotal of the exact source charge identified through the refund authorization and its rate-error review.

## Basis Q&A
**What governs assisted correction posting here?** Read the posted net service subtotal of the exact source charge identified through the refund authorization and its rate-error review.
